title: Free tutorial: A risk register row a board understands
summary: Write risks with likelihood, impact, an owner and a date, so leadership can decide.
tools: Compliance gap check (ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DPDP, CERT-In)

script.intro: Welcome. A risk register is only useful if a board can decide from it. In this tutorial you fix a register that has holes and add the risks the threat model found.
script.outro: A good row names who owns it, what we will do and by when. Seminar 10 builds the whole design, risk and audit pack for the Parent Pay launch.
steps: Read the setting so you know the company, the date and the time zone. Then open the evidence in the case folder.

The first register has no owners, no treatment, and a high risk marked accepted with nobody's name on it. Load it into the risk tool. Every row needs a likelihood, an impact, an owner, a treatment and a date. Multiply likelihood by impact: fifteen or more is high. Accepting a risk is a real choice, but it belongs to someone senior enough to pay for the consequence, so a high risk accepted without sign-off gets flagged. Fix the rows, then add the new risks. When every row passes, you have a register someone can act on.
A good row names who owns it, what we will do and by when. Seminar 10 builds the whole design, risk and audit pack for the Parent Pay launch.
